activationRule: Continuation of the owner's 2026-09-11 goal-mode directive ('significantly improve the project... across the entire frontend') after Campaign 024 closed VALIDATED. Campaign 024 applied the shared answer-feedback language to eight category canaries and the late-tap games; 31 game boards still carry their own verdict styling. This campaign closes that consistency gap and wires real round progress into the shared HUD.
validationNote: All 31 remaining boards adopted the shared verdict language (soft fill + verdict border + ✓/✕/⏱ badge + verdict in the accessible name; wrong pick shown with the correct answer where the mechanic reveals it; prompt mounted through feedback; feedback derived from the reducer's resolved outcome) and 41 of 42 games report HUD roundProgress (memory-sequence-memory is a time-boxed score attack with no total in state and keeps the round chip per HUD R2). Presentation-only diff: no mechanics, scoring, generator, persistence or testID changes. Evidence: tsc clean, Jest 535 suites / 6409 tests PASS (5 allowlisted skips), expo lint clean, all repository validators PASS, autobot canaries 8/8 PASS on a dev build at the closure SHA, and native before/after board pairs in qa-artifacts/campaign025/boards-{before,after}/**. The daily-workout journey and a release artifact from this SHA were not re-run; those are explicitly NOT VALIDATED for this campaign.
